articles.summary: In both physical and digital commerce, trust is foundational. As retailers explore new ways to serve customers through conversational AI, expectations are shifting. AI systems are no longer just answering questions—they’re helping users discover, compare, and move toward decisions in more guided, collaborative ways. This evolution toward agentic AI—systems that take initiative and help users...
articles.title: Designing Responsible Agentic AI for Retail: A Product Perspective
